newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Colly sees firm cotton prices.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Colly sees firm cotton prices.

text.p: Australian cotton producer Colly Cotton Ltd said on Monday the world outlook for cotton prices was firm given recent downward revisions in supply forecasts.
"The outlook for cotton prices is firm," Colly Cotton managing director David Farley told reporters.
Colly Cotton is forecasting an Australian bale price, net of freight, handling and exchange movements of A$471 per bale in 1996/97, down from the A$483 realised in the six months to June 30, 1996.
Earlier, Colly said it would issue 107 million shares at A$1.00 per share and forecast production of 180,700 bales in the year to June 30, 1997, up from 22,400 in the drought affected 1995/96 year.
Argentinian based investor John Kahlbetzer would take up 25 percent of the issue and units of current Colly Cotton owner, Commonwealth Funds Management, would also take 25 percent of the issue.
